title: Row With the Maximum Number of Ones
description: Each row of a binary matrix is sorted in non-decreasing order. Return the 0-based index of the row containing the most ones. If multiple rows tie, return the smallest index; if the matrix contains no ones, return -1. Input: `mat`. Output: the selected row index or -1.
constraints: Each row contains only 0s followed by 1s
hints: Check each cell using its row and column relationships.
Handle single-row, single-column, tie, and center-cell cases explicitly.
